Where the accepted row carries no full_text, the verbatim citation check falls back to regeste/title/snippet and is reported as such (39 of 46 rows are checkable; 18 match verbatim).

counter_markers is absent from every accepted counter row, so the product's reported marker precision cannot be measured on the accepted chain; the document-wide-only marker column (27 of 39 replication rows) is the measurable proxy for the audited scope defect.

The class-aware audit contract cannot distinguish a producer file carrying the COMPLETE audit signature (required_fixes + safe_to_integrate + team) from a genuine independent audit.
